question: Welche Migrantengruppe hat, abgesehen von den in Deutschland Geborenen, bei Frauen im Alter von 30-40 eine Erwerbstätigenquote von etwa 60-70%?
question_english: Which migrant group, aside from those born in Germany, has an employment rate of approximately 60-70% for women aged 30-40?
model_answer:
Here’s a concise answer to your question based on the figure:

The figure shows that migrants who were born outside of Germany (“zugewandert”) have a consistently higher employment rate among women aged 30-40 compared to those born in Germany (“ohne Migrationshintergrund”).  Both groups experienced fluctuations over time, but the migrant group consistently maintained a rate of around 60-70%.  Notably, the migrant group’s employment rate plummeted after age 50.
